component.name: Open Spark
component.summary: Build and tune your OBS scene by talking to it

description.p: Open Spark adds a conversational agent dock to OBS Studio. Describe an overlay, a camera layout, a filter or a whole scene in plain language and a local LLM agent calls OBS for you to make it happen.
Local-first and LLM-agnostic — Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, NVIDIA NIM, OpenRouter or a local Ollama / vLLM model. Destructive actions run in dry-run and ask for confirmation first.
This extension ships only the native OBS plugin. It talks over loopback to the Open Spark Python backend, which you run separately (see the project README).
First public MVP: conversational agent dock, slash shortcuts, natural-language overlays, camera / filter / scene control.
